title: Team Marketplace, Security Review, Cursor SDK, and Multi-tasking Agents
description: Admins can create team marketplaces without connecting repositories first. Security Review feature enters beta for Teams and Enterprise with Security Reviewer and Vulnerability Scanner agents. Cursor SDK launches in public beta for building programmatic agents. Multi-tasking with /multitask for async subagents, improved worktrees, multi-root workspaces, and interactive Canvases feature.

title: Cascade AI Agent with Flows Architecture
description: Windsurf Editor features Cascade, an AI agent combining deep codebase understanding, advanced tools, and real-time awareness. Includes full contextual awareness, command suggestion and execution, multi-file editing, Windsurf Previews for live app viewing, MCP support, Tab to Jump navigation, Supercomplete, In-line Command, Codelenses, and highlighted code actions.

title: Version 0.56.0: Prompt Caching, Report Command, and Chat Language Settings
description: Enables prompt caching for Sonnet via OpenRouter, 8k output tokens for Sonnet via VertexAI and DeepSeek V2.5. New /report command for pre-populated GitHub Issues, --chat-language switch for spoken language, improved shell command suggestions, key import checks on launch, renamed --models to --list-models, and numerous bug fixes.

title: Week 17 Updates: Ultrareview, Session Recaps, Custom Themes, and Redesigned Web Experience
description: /ultrareview opens as a research preview for bug-hunting agents, automatic session recaps when returning to terminal, custom color themes in plugins, and a redesigned claude.ai/code with sessions sidebar and drag-and-drop layout. Other improvements include Vim visual mode, MCP tool hooks, /usage command merger, and 67% faster /resume on large sessions.
